connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.1: fix episodes extract for the app validator - every html field mapping needs a selector; collection is now li.episode with fields read from the inner a[data-id] anchor. 0.3.0: migration to animeunity.at (animeunity.so is down): home + /filter catalogue, search via /filter?keyword=, details from the title page, episodes via /ajax/episode/list, streams through server link-id (/ajax/server -> /embed/source -> HLS), variant-gated by the site's own sub/dub server type.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
